response.rationale: Severe high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis is present; among supplied candidates, lactic acidosis is the closest fit despite normal lactate, while salicylate, DKA, and renal tubular acidosis are directly contradicted by negative salicylate, absent ketones, and unchanged renal function.

rejected.why: Salicylate level <0.4 mmol/L directly contradicts salicylate toxicity.
Blood ketones <0.2 mmol/L directly contradicts diabetic ketoacidosis.
Creatinine is at baseline and renal function is explicitly insufficient to explain the acidosis; high anion gap is not characteristic of RTA.
